title: Member Handbook: Effective Dates of Primary Care Provider Assignment Changes
content:
A change of primary care provider under the **Primary Care Provider Assignment** does not take effect on the day it is asked for. Its effective date follows from the date of the request, the monthly cutoff day and the reason for the change.

**The rule.** A routine change requested on or before the cutoff day of a month takes effect on the first day of the next month, and one requested after it takes effect on the first day of the month after next. Where the practice type provides for next-day effect for cause, a change for provider left network, provider dismissal or access problem takes effect the calendar day after the request. No change is ever back-dated beyond the practice type's back-dating allowance, and the member may withdraw a pending change at any time before its effective date.

| Practice type | Monthly cutoff day | Next-day effect for cause | Back-dating allowed (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 20 | Yes | 0 |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | 20 | Yes | 0 |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | 20 | Yes | 0 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 20 | Yes | 0 |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 20 | Yes | 0 |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 20 | Yes | 0 |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 20 | Yes | 0 |

With a back-dating allowance of 0 days, no change takes effect before the date of the request.

**Calendar cases (hypothetical request dates)**

| Request | Date asked | Effective date |
|---|---|---|
| Routine change | 20 March, the cutoff day itself | 1 April |
| Routine change | 21 March, the day after the cutoff | 1 May |
| Routine change | 5 November | 1 December |
| Routine change | 28 November | 1 January of the following year |
| Change for access problem | 21 March | 22 March |
| Change for provider left network | 31 December | 1 January of the following year |

**Withdrawal.** A member who asked on 10 June for a routine change effective 1 July may withdraw it on any day up to and including 30 June. From 1 July the assignment is no longer pending.
